title: Pokemon Emerald Seaglass (v3.0)
sources: The ROM itself (Emerald Seaglass 3.0, pokeemerald-expansion based): region map section names (each place resolves to a section with maps) and trainer names, teams and levels, read on the PC with throwaway tools
pret/pokeemerald: Emerald's story order and fight places, which Seaglass keeps
pokemonemeraldseaglass.com, PokéHarbor (2024-08) and poke-hack-hub: features, retypes, evolution items
A fan 'Professor Oak Challenge' guide for Seaglass 3.0 (Google Docs): legendary locations

milestones.name: Rival: first battle (Route 103)
milestones.tips: May or Brendan (whichever you didn't pick; both are playable since 3.0) uses the starter strong against yours at Lv 5.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Aqua in Petalburg Woods
milestones.tips: A grunt with a Lv 9 Wailmer bothers a Devon researcher. Grass or Electric moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 1: Roxanne
milestones.badge_note: Stone Badge: Cut (Seaglass needs the HM and the badge, not a move slot).
milestones.tips: Rock types (fossils first): Anorith, Lileep, Nosepass (Lv 12-15). Water, Grass, Fighting and Steel moves; Lileep is Grass/Rock (Ice, Fighting, Bug, Steel).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Aqua in Rusturf Tunnel
milestones.tips: A grunt with stolen Devon goods: Lv 11 Wailmer. Mr. Briney then sails you to Dewford.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Rival: Rustboro City
milestones.tips: Your neighbour's second team, Lv 13-15.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 2: Brawly
milestones.tips: Fighting types: Makuhita, Meditite, Heracross (Lv 16-19). Psychic, Flying and Fairy moves; Heracross takes four times from Flying.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Aqua at the Oceanic Museum
milestones.tips: Two grunts at the museum (the ROM's at 14-15: Lombre and Carvanha). Electric and Grass moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Rival: Route 110
milestones.tips: Three Pokémon now, the starter's second stage at Lv 20.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 3: Wattson
milestones.tips: Electric types: Volbeat, Flaaffy, Magneton, Manectric (Lv 20-24). Ground moves above all; Volbeat is Bug (Fire, Flying, Rock).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Magma at Mt. Chimney
milestones.tips: Tabitha (Numel, Poochyena, Dunsparce, Houndour (Lv 18-22)) and Maxie (Mightyena, Gligar, Camerupt (Lv 24-25)) at the summit. Water and Ground moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 4: Flannery
milestones.tips: Fire types: Slugma, Flareon, Camerupt, Torkoal (Lv 24-29). Water, Ground and Rock moves; Camerupt takes four times from Water.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 5: Norman
milestones.tips: Normal types: Spinda, Vigoroth, Politoed, Slaking (Lv 27-31). Fighting moves; Politoed is Water (Grass, Electric). Slaking loafs every other turn: protect or switch on its active turns.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Wally in Mauville
milestones.tips: Wally challenges you outside the gym with his Lv 16 Ralts.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Aqua at the Weather Institute
milestones.tips: Shelly: Ludicolo, Mightyena (Lv 28). Flying or Poison moves for Ludicolo, Fighting or Fairy for Mightyena.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Rival: Route 119
milestones.tips: Lv 29-31 team; they give you HM02 Fly afterwards.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 6: Winona
milestones.tips: Flying types: Fearow, Tropius, Pelipper, Skarmory, Altaria (Lv 29-33). Electric, Ice and Rock moves; Skarmory is Steel/Flying (Fire, Electric).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Rival: Lilycove City
milestones.tips: Their last team: the final starter stage at Lv 36.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Mt. Pyre and the Magma Hideout
milestones.tips: The orb is taken from Mt. Pyre; in the Magma Hideout Tabitha (Numel, Dodrio, Murkrow, Camerupt (Lv 26-33)) and Maxie (Gliscor, Crobat, Ursaring, Camerupt (Lv 37-39)) wake Groudon. Water moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Aqua Hideout
milestones.tips: Matt: Mightyena, Golbat (Lv 34). Electric moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 7: Tate & Liza
milestones.tips: A double battle: Claydol, Mismagius, Lunatone, Solrock (Lv 41-42). Dark, Ghost, Water and Grass moves; Lunatone and Solrock fear Water and Grass.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Team Magma at the Space Center
milestones.tips: A double battle beside Steven (Metang, Skarmory, Aggron (Lv 42-44)) against Tabitha (Camerupt, Dodrio, Honchkrow (Lv 36-40)) and Maxie (Gliscor, Crobat, Shiftry, Ursaluna, Dodrio, Camerupt (Lv 42-44)).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Seafloor Cavern: Archie
milestones.tips: Archie: Wailord, Breloom, Crobat, Sharpedo (Lv 41-43). Electric moves for Wailord, Sharpedo and Crobat; Flying or Psychic for Breloom. Shelly's later team in the ROM is Sharpedo, Whiscash (Lv 37).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Rayquaza at Sky Pillar
milestones.tips: With both box legends awake over Sootopolis, climb Sky Pillar to wake Rayquaza and end the storm.
milestones.source: pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Gym 8: Juan
milestones.tips: Water types: Starmie, Whiscash, Sealeo, Octillery, Kingdra (Lv 41-46). Electric and Grass moves; Kingdra is Water/Dragon (Dragon, Fairy).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Wally (Victory Road)
milestones.tips: Altaria, Delcatty, Roserade, Magnezone, Gardevoir (Lv 41-45). Fire for Roserade, Ice for Altaria, Steel or Poison for Gardevoir.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Elite Four: Sidney
milestones.tips: Mightyena, Honchkrow, Cacturne, Crawdaunt, Absol (Lv 46-49). Fighting, Bug and Fairy moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Elite Four: Phoebe
milestones.tips: Dusclops, Froslass, Mismagius, Banette, Dusknoir (Lv 48-51). Dark and Ghost moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Elite Four: Glacia
milestones.tips: Dewgong, Glalie, Glaceon, Cloyster, Walrein (Lv 50-53). Fire, Fighting, Rock and Steel moves.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Elite Four: Drake
milestones.tips: Kingdra, Altaria, Steelix, Flygon, Salamence (Lv 52-55). Ice, Dragon and Fairy moves; Steelix wants Fire or Ground.
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

milestones.name: Champion Wallace
milestones.tips: Wailord, Tentacruel, Ludicolo, Whiscash, Gyarados, Milotic (Lv 55-58). Electric and Grass moves; Ludicolo and Whiscash need others (Flying/Poison, Grass).
milestones.source: ROM Seaglass 3.0 trainer table; pret/pokeemerald story order (Seaglass keeps Emerald's)

steps.title: Set the difficulty in your room
steps.text: The book in your room turns Hard Mode (set style, no items in trainer battles) and the soft level cap (less EXP over the cap) on or off. The GameCube there takes cheat codes.

steps.title: Get a Linking Cord
steps.text: Lanette's house on Route 114 gives a Linking Cord for trade evolutions; more are prizes at the Mossdeep pinball.

steps.title: Rustboro wishing well
steps.text: Wishing Stars bought in the Rustboro wishing well give random Lv 1 Pokémon.

steps.title: Evolution stones in Lavaridge
steps.text: The Lavaridge herb shop sells the Leaf, Ice, Shiny and Dawn Stones.

steps.title: Z-Ring from Devon
steps.text: Devon gives a Z-Ring; Z-Crystals are sold in a shop.

secrets.text: With the Eon Ticket: Latias or Latios on Southern Island.
secrets.source: fan Professor Oak Challenge guide for Seaglass 3.0 (Google Docs)

secrets.text: With the Old Sea Map: Mew on Faraway Island.
secrets.source: fan Professor Oak Challenge guide for Seaglass 3.0 (Google Docs)

secrets.text: With the Aurora Ticket: Deoxys on Birth Island.
secrets.source: fan Professor Oak Challenge guide for Seaglass 3.0 (Google Docs)

secrets.text: Hold a Wishing Star at the white rock in Mossdeep for Jirachi.
secrets.source: fan Professor Oak Challenge guide for Seaglass 3.0 (Google Docs)

secrets.text: The Safari Zone is buggy: save first. Mudkip lives in the south-west, Larvitar and Torchic in the north-west (Mach Bike).
Pinball tables in Mauville and Mossdeep pay out prizes, Linking Cords among them.
Magnezone: level Magneton in New Mauville, or use a Thunder Stone.

evolutions.name: Kadabra
evolutions.text: The Linking Cord evolves it (and the other trade evolutions) without a trade.

evolutions.name: Onix
evolutions.text: Metal Coat gives Steelix; Scyther takes the Metal Coat for Scizor or the Black Augurite for Kleavor.

evolutions.name: Magnemite
evolutions.text: Magnemite's line: Magneton, then Magnezone by Thunder Stone or levelling in New Mauville.

evolutions.name: Pichu
evolutions.text: Since 3.0 a Light Ball works for the Pichu line.

notes.title: Emerald Seaglass 3.0
notes.text: Emerald redrawn in a Game Boy Color style with Emerald's story. All Gen I-III species, their later evolutions and a few newer ones; Fairy type and the split. 3.0 adds Brendan and May as playable and new leader sprites.

notes.title: Retyped Pokémon
notes.text: Noctowl Ghost/Flying, Sceptile Grass/Dragon, Octillery Water/Fire, Meganium Grass/Fairy, Typhlosion Fire/Ground, Feraligatr Water/Dark, Blastoise Water/Steel, Hypno Psychic/Dark, Aggron Steel/Dragon, Huntail Water/Dragon, Gorebyss Water/Fairy, Ninjask Bug/Dark.

notes.title: Features
notes.text: Followers (can be turned off), DexNav, Box Link (the PC anywhere), HMs without move slots, party Exp. Share, Z-Moves, a shiny charm and a type-effectiveness display.
